text: Immunology is a core discipline that studies the structure and function of the body's immune system. It mainly explores how the immune system recognizes "self" and "non-self", resists pathogen invasion, maintains the body's homeostasis, and the mechanisms of immune abnormalities (such as allergies, autoimmune diseases, and immune deficiencies). As an interdisciplinary field of medicine and biology, it not only belongs to the basic research domain (such as immune cell differentiation and signal transduction), but also directly serves clinical practice (such as vaccine development and tumor immunotherapy). Modern immunology has been deeply integrated with genetics, molecular biology and bioinformatics, and has become a key discipline for conquering major diseases (such as AIDS and cancer) and innovating biotechnologies.
